scope: Actual UI/Renderer and successful Game.deploy commands after real energy regeneration. All positions, facing, attacks and Log pushes come from Game.step at 60 simulation steps/s; no actor positions, stats, directions or hit timers are assigned. The capture is a deterministic functional check, not a measured 60FPS performance claim.
